summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing an Amended and Restated 2025 Statement of Executive Compensation. This is a routine executive compensation disclosure, filed to correct clerical errors in a prior version. It is a required regulatory filing for a Canadian foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The filing address is solely executive compensation practices for the 2025 financial year.
